imp: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for an original 1993 DOS fantasy blobber, World of Maxxia. Crisp full-colour hand-painted pixel art, expressive pre-rendered fantasy look at low resolution, hard pixel clusters, strong silhouette, shaded anatomy, no vector appearance. A mischievous DUST IMP, wiry ochre brown humanoid with swept horns, long pointed ears, turquoise glowing eyes, tattered violet waistcloth, claw hands, small bat wings, brass bell on belt. Full body front three-quarter facing viewer. EXACT uniform 4 columns by 4 rows grid, 16 equal square cells, no gutters, NO labels/text/borders. Transparent background. Each pose within central 75% of its cell with generous transparent padding. All frames consistent identity, size, ground baseline. Row 1 and row 2: eight sequential distinct idle poses, breathing, curling fingers, flicking tail and wings. Row 3 cells 1-3: attack anticipation arm back, lunge claw swipe, follow-through. Row 3 cell4: recoiling hit pose. Row 4: four death frames crouch clutching chest, knees buckling, collapsing sideways, final crumpled body. This is a usable aligned sprite sheet, not a poster. No shadows outside each cell. Square overall canvas.
tavern: Use case: stylized-concept. Original DOS 1993 fantasy RPG pixel art game background, World of Maxxia Silver Lantern Tavern. Wide landscape 11:7 composition, illustrated interior seen from customer side of counter, welcoming middle-aged auburn curly haired woman innkeeper Tessa Bell smiling directly at player, weathered warm face, teal blouse and cream apron, one hand resting on dark wood bar, silver lantern suspended above, brass bells and old maps, shelves of ceramic mugs, amber bottles, arched stained-glass windows showing a blue harbour twilight, hearth with glowing coals, cozy patrons as background silhouettes. Detailed hand-painted realistic fantasy pixel art with deliberate hard pixel clusters, rich warm ochre and amber light contrasted blue shadows, expressive character portrait style like early Might and Magic games, excellent face readability at 440 by 280 pixels. Entire background fills frame. No text, no interface, no borders. Character occupies middle third with fully visible head and hands. Original artwork not copying any reference character.
portrait: Use case: stylized-concept. A usable portrait-state atlas for original DOS fantasy RPG World of Maxxia. EXACT four equal vertical columns in single horizontal row, each same rectangular head-and-shoulders composition, overall wide 3:1 image. NO margins or gutters. Same original adult female witch in each of four cells: tan skin, dark expressive eyes, wavy black hair, broad dark violet witch hat, brass earring, teal collar, determined clever expression, realistic fantasy pixel portrait 1993 hand-painted game art with crisp hard pixels, rich strong colour clusters. Fixed camera and matched face proportions across cells. Cell1 normal alert confident portrait; cell2 hurt with small cut on cheek and pained grimace; cell3 afflicted with sickly greenish face and exhausted expression; cell4 DEAD state is ancient grey stone grave marker with carved crescent and small ivy on dark violet background, not a face. Each cell fills its area, shoulders cropped at bottom. Dark midnight blue backdrop. Intended displayed at only 58 by 70 pixels each so emphasize bold facial features and contrast. No text or UI frame. Not vector, not cartoon emoji.
